tickets.label: ready-for-agent

tickets.title: Reconcile subscription money through bank settlement
tickets.delivers: An operator reconciles invoices and gross payments through fees, refunds, tax, FX, settlements and bank receipts.
criteria: Import/record authoritative settlement and bank-receipt evidence through explicit adapters or authorized manual entry.
Link transaction and settlement currencies/amounts, fee taxes, refunds and exchange-rate evidence without using the planning FX rate as an actual rate.
Show expected versus observed totals, unresolved differences, attributable review/resolution and accounting exports.
Keep collected tax separate from subscription revenue/margin and exclude separately customer-paid Meta charges from the operator's payment ledger.
tickets.label: ready-for-agent

tickets.title: Prepare tax periods and review liability reports
tickets.delivers: A platform operator manages tax obligations, due periods and reviewable liability reports from retained subscription transactions.
criteria: Maintain configured registration/obligation records, reporting periods and due dates without inventing universal legal deadlines.
Aggregate issued invoice/credit-note snapshots and applicable adjustments into explainable liability totals tied to their underlying evidence.
Record preparer/reviewer actions, review issues and approvals; give operators a due/status view and deterministic clock-based reminders.
Business users cannot access global tax data; preparing or approving a period does not claim it is filed or paid.
tickets.label: ready-for-agent

tickets.title: Record tax filing and remittance confirmations
tickets.delivers: An authorized operator exports a reviewed period and records supported filing/payment confirmations with retained evidence.
criteria: Generate accounting/filing exports and support authorized manual or explicitly supported external submission/remittance adapters.
Record submission/payment references, supporting files, approvals and acknowledgements as distinct steps with attributable status history.
An export, attempted submission or payment initiation alone never marks an obligation filed/paid; reconcile confirmations and liabilities idempotently.
Keep unknown jurisdiction/adapter configuration unavailable and exercise failed/ambiguous/replayed confirmation fixtures with operator-only access.
tickets.label: ready-for-agent

tickets.title: Report discovery quality and sales outcomes honestly
tickets.delivers: A Business reviews discovery quality, engagement, conversion outcomes, communication health and human effort without inflated counts.
criteria: Report fit/source coverage, deduplication, named-buyer/contact accuracy, request freshness and discovery cost using explainable metric denominators and provenance.
Keep evidence-backed matches, contactable prospects, direct engagement, RFQs, issued quotes, requested/confirmed/attended appointments and sales distinct.
Show response/qualification coverage, opt-outs, complaints, sender pauses, handoffs, next actions and recorded human effort across supported channels.
Apply Business/role isolation and honest unavailable/estimated/stale data labels; customer-paid Meta usage stays separate from platform allowances and operator costs.
tickets.label: ready-for-agent

tickets.title: Track operator costs and alert on global budgets
tickets.delivers: An operator sees cross-provider spend and a month-end forecast with configurable global/category alerts.
criteria: Track fixed commitments, metered hosting/database/worker usage, AI/search/tools, payment/provisioning and recorded setup/support/sales effort with explicit source, allocation and freshness.
Separate OpenAI credits and existing subscription allocation, BYOK provider spend, Gateway prepaid cash/consumption/fallback and customer-paid Meta charges without double counting.
Configure global/category monthly budgets and default alert thresholds at 80/90/100 percent; show forecast assumptions and deduplicate notifications.
Keep global budget reporting separate from per-run authorization and extra-spend approvals; missing rates/budgets are explicit rather than invented caps or free usage.
Record selected-plan cost changes and unpriced items, retaining INR planning conversion as a labeled assumption rather than customer billing/actual FX.
tickets.label: ready-for-agent

tickets.title: Inspect failures, action history and safe recovery
tickets.delivers: Authorized users inspect failed runs/actions, understand their policy context and recover safe work without duplicate external effects.
criteria: Provide Business-scoped action/history and separate operator run/queue/channel/health views with sources, approval/authority context, blocked reasons and responsible next actions.
Redact credentials and private payloads, apply configured diagnostic/audit retention and link useful provider-native logs without adding another observability subscription.
Expose retry/reconcile/escalate controls that honor current authority, ownership, budget and idempotency; ambiguous sends or bookings cannot be blindly replayed.
Recover a failed run/connection fixture and verify correct progress, alert ownership and preserved history after a worker restart.
tickets.label: ready-for-agent

tickets.title: Export retained data and offboard Business connections
tickets.delivers: A Business exports permitted records and offboards under explicit retention/cancellation policies without losing protected financial history or leaking credentials.
criteria: Provide authorized exports of retained prospects/evidence/conversations with contract-aware scope and immutable financial-document history.
Manage explicit access, retention/deletion and cancellation policies; missing production policy remains visible rather than inventing legal retention periods.
Stop/revoke affected jobs and external connections, clean up retained files/tokens through accountable retryable steps and preserve required invoice/tax evidence.
Show number/account control/transfer and incomplete revocation status, retain the agreed records after reach reduction, and test cross-Business and signed-link isolation.
tickets.label: ready-for-agent

tickets.title: Purchase and schedule reserved discovery capacity
tickets.delivers: A Business with the configured paid entitlement uses reserved capacity while pooled execution remains the default.
criteria: Quote and confirm configured optional reserved capacity through the subscription contract rather than assigning unapproved extra spend.
Route queued runs to the appropriate pooled/reserved execution allowance with visible progress and capacity availability.
Use identical Business isolation, permission, source, budget and evidence rules in both modes; dedicated capacity is not a privacy prerequisite.
Handle entitlement change, exhaustion and retries without duplicated runs or promises of guaranteed leads/throughput beyond configured capacity.
tickets.label: ready-for-agent

tickets.title: Recover an isolated Business after infrastructure failure
tickets.delivers: An operator deploys the selected stack and demonstrates recovery of a Business's records and durable work in an isolated environment.
criteria: Configure isolated environments, server-only secrets and deliberate supported Vercel/Neon/Trigger regions, preserving pooled runtime versus direct migration access and non-bypassed RLS.

Apply/recover a reviewed migration and restore representative Business data and queued work in a disposable recovery environment, verifying application-visible records and no duplicate outbound effects.
Record configured backup/restore objectives, retention and file-recovery limitations; do not claim an untested recovery guarantee or Virginia placement for R2.
Expose actionable health/readiness evidence and reconcile the selected service/retention costs; production setup requires actual credentials and verified environment configuration.
tickets.label: ready-for-agent

tickets.title: Deliver authentication and platform notices through Resend
tickets.delivers: Users receive authorized authentication, invitation and platform notices through the selected transactional stream with visible delivery/setup status.
criteria: Connect the transactional notification adapter to Resend and provide verified platform sender/setup status with safe, scoped notification content.
Exercise an auth/invitation flow from user action through persisted notification attempt and delivery/result visibility, including retry and provider failure.
Use it only for auth/platform notices; customer first-contact prospecting never enters the stream and Resend receiving quotas do not become mailbox-sync capability.
Retain free-band volume/eligibility limits, rate handling and actual usage/cost attribution; paid upgrades require explicit selected terms rather than hidden activation.
tickets.label: ready-for-agent

tickets.title: Prepare paid pilots, enforce preflight and record renewal
tickets.delivers: An operator prepares a bounded paid pilot, sees missing live prerequisites and records measured results, paid renewal and a contrasting second workflow.
criteria: Capture the actual pilot Business/offering, goal, baseline, numeric success criteria, scope, approved cash/time/spend limits and upfront pilot/renewal quote without invented commercial defaults.
Show capability-specific preflight for current authority/MFA, source/market coverage, budgets, retention/offboarding, tax/billing configuration and chosen sender/mailbox/WhatsApp/calendar paths.

Live Exa activation requires completion evidence from existing issue #2; other provider credentials, verification/assessment costs and approvals remain explicit runtime launch gates rather than coding blockers.

Require separately validated selected channel/account paths and truthful sender/reply readiness; unsupported or unconfigured capabilities stay unavailable while deterministic workflows remain demonstrable.

Record measured quality, sales outcomes, channel health, contribution inputs and an evidence-backed paid renewal; only then record the materially different workflow used to assess configuration reuse.
Completing the software/checklist does not claim that a real pilot, provider approval, legal review or paid renewal has already happened.
tickets.label: ready-for-agent

tickets.title: Validate the separate UPI AutoPay mandate-change flow
tickets.delivers: An operator validates the separate UPI upgrade/new-mandate path before optionally enabling UPI AutoPay for eligible subscriptions.
criteria: Keep UPI disabled during the initial cards-only release and recheck current gateway/account support before implementation.
Demonstrate the required approved payment/new-mandate flow, failed/recovered authorizations, renewal cancellation and idempotent entitlement transitions.
Do not treat UPI subscription changes as equivalent to eligible international-card updates or migrate an existing mandate silently.
Record supported account/method limits and sandbox/provider evidence; activation requires the explicit validated configuration and customer approval.
tickets.stage: Deferred after recurring cards; does not block the initial pilot
tickets.label: ready-for-agent
